rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for air, weather, or your body feeling uncomfortably cold.

example.english: It’s chilly today, so I need to put on more clothes.
example.traditional: 今日天氣好凍，我要着多件衫。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 dung3 ngo5 jiu3 zoek6 do1 gin6 saam1

rows.note: Use this for a person, manner, or look that feels distant and unfriendly rather than physically cold.

example.english: Their attitude toward me was chilly, and I don’t know what I did to offend them.
example.traditional: 佢對住我個樣好冷淡，我都唔知得罪咗佢乜嘢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zyu6 ngo5 go3 joeng6 hou2 laang5 daam6 ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 dak1 zeoi6 zo2 keoi5 mat1 je5
